paper_id: StegGuard_ Fingerprinting Self-supervised Pre-trained Encoders via Secrets Embeder and Extractor
title: StegGuard: Fingerprinting Self-supervised Pre-trained Encoders via Secrets Embeder and Extractor
motivation: EaaS模式下预训练编码器面临被窃取的商业威胁
problem_framing: 把IP保护问题定义为"找独特指纹"来区分受害者vs独立编码器
key_insight: 嵌入和提取秘密的能力依赖每个编码器的唯一变换函数，盗版因依赖受害者所以变换函数相似
method_signature: 联合学习嵌入器和提取器+FcaEmb频率域注意力块
evaluation_criteria: ebr错误率、p值、Δμ差异、PSNR/SSIM图像质量
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 秘密太短性能不保证，太长嵌入提取不可行
evidence_for_taste: transform function of each individual encoder
the learned secrets embeder and extractor can reasonably become fingerprint
pirate encoder has a similar transformation to the victim
p-value of DI has a large increase, while StegGuard still remains stable
thinking_moves: 把IP保护问题重新框为通信问题-利用编码器唯一变换特性
把"验证编码器归属"转译为"能否从嵌入向量正确提取秘密"
通过GradCAM可视化解释为什么相似编码器有相似特征提取能力
端到端联合优化嵌入器和提取器而非修改编码器本身
